segments.src: ## Indicators that give a fuller picture

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers without overreacting
segments.tr: ## How to read the numbers without overreacting

segments.src: - **Look at trends, not single weeks.** Weekly claims are noisy. Holidays, seasonal patterns, and local events such as weather or a plant closure can shift a single reading. A four-week average smooths some of this out.
segments.tr: - **Look at trends, not single weeks.** Weekly claims are noisy. Holidays, seasonal patterns, and local events such as weather or a plant closure can shift a single reading. A four-week average smooths some of this out.

segments.src: - **Compare across indicators.** If claims are low but hires and quits are also low, the market is probably stable but stagnant, not strong.
segments.tr: - **Compare across indicators.** If claims are low but hires and quits are also low, the market is probably stable but stagnant, not strong.

segments.src: - **Remember that "low" is relative.** The labor force is much larger than in past decades, so a low count of claims should be viewed alongside the size of the workforce.

segments.src: - **Expect revisions.** Many labor statistics are revised after first publication, and the story can change.

segments.src: ## What this means for job seekers and workers
segments.tr: ## What this means for job seekers and workers

segments.src: Low layoffs are good news for people who are currently employed, but they do not guarantee that the search for a new role will be quick.
segments.tr: Low layoffs are good news for people who are currently employed, but they do not guarantee that the search for a new role will be quick.

segments.src: If you are looking for work, some practical steps may help:
segments.tr: If you are looking for work, some practical steps may help:

segments.src: - Focus on sectors and regions where hiring data shows real activity.

segments.src: - Expect longer timelines and plan your finances accordingly.
segments.tr: - Expect longer timelines and plan your finances accordingly.

segments.src: - Keep skills and professional networks current, since many openings are filled through referrals.
segments.tr: - Keep skills and professional networks current, since many openings are filled through referrals.

segments.src: - Consider the full compensation picture, not just the headline salary, when weighing offers.
segments.tr: - Consider the full compensation picture, not just the headline salary, when weighing offers.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## The bottom line

segments.src: Jobless claims are a useful early warning for layoffs, and a very low reading signals that employers are not shedding workers in large numbers.
segments.tr: Jobless claims are a useful early warning for layoffs, and a very low reading signals that employers are not shedding workers in large numbers.

segments.src: But a healthy-looking claims figure and a sluggish hiring environment are not contradictory.
segments.tr: But a healthy-looking claims figure and a sluggish hiring environment are not contradictory.

segments.src: To judge how the job market is really doing, look at claims together with hires, quits, openings, duration of unemployment, and wage trends.

segments.tr: 2. **नौकरी के अवसर और श्रम टर्नओवर (JOLTS)**। श्रम सांख्यिकी ब्यूरो का सर्वेक्षण रिक्तियों, भर्तियों, छोड़ने और छंटनी की रिपोर्ट करता है। बाजार कितना गतिशील है, यह आंकने के लिए *भर्ती दर (hires rate)* और *छोड़ने की दर (quits rate)* विशेष रूप से उपयोगी हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Monthly payroll employment.** The jobs report shows net job growth. Pay attention to revisions, since early estimates are often adjusted later.
segments.tr: 3. **मासिक पेरोल रोजगार**। नौकरियों की रिपोर्ट शुद्ध नौकरी वृद्धि दिखाती है। संशोधनों पर ध्यान दें, क्योंकि शुरुआती अनुमानों को अक्सर बाद में समायोजित किया जाता है।

segments.src: 4. **The unemployment rate and its duration breakdown.** A rising share of long-term unemployed workers suggests that finding work is getting harder, even if the overall rate looks stable.
segments.tr: 4. **बेरोजगारी दर और इसकी अवधि का टूटना**। दीर्घकालिक बेरोजगार श्रमिकों का बढ़ता हिस्सा यह सुझाव देता है कि काम पाना कठिन हो रहा है, भले ही समग्र दर स्थिर दिखाई दे।

segments.src: 5. **Labor force participation and the employment-population ratio.** These show whether people are working or looking, or have stepped away from the market.
segments.tr: 5. **श्रम बल भागीदारी और रोजगार-जनसंख्या अनुपात**। ये दर्शाते हैं कि लोग काम कर रहे हैं या तलाश कर रहे हैं, या बाजार से दूर हो गए हैं।

segments.src: 6. **Wage growth.** Measures such as the Employment Cost Index and average hourly earnings indicate whether employers are competing for workers.
segments.tr: 6. **मजदूरी में वृद्धि**। रोजगार लागत सूचकांक और औसत प्रति घंटा की कमाई जैसे उपाय यह संकेत देते हैं कि क्या नियोक्ता श्रमिकों के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: 7. **Surveys of workers and employers.** Consumer confidence surveys often ask whether jobs are "plentiful" or "hard to get," and business surveys ask about hiring plans. These capture sentiment that hard counts miss.
segments.tr: 7. **श्रमिकों और नियोक्ताओं के सर्वेक्षण**। उपभोक्ता विश्वास सर्वेक्षण अक्सर पूछते हैं कि क्या नौकरियां "प्रचुर मात्रा में" हैं या "पाना कठिन" हैं, और व्यवसाय सर्वेक्षण भर्ती योजनाओं के बारे में पूछते हैं। ये उस भावना को पकड़ते हैं जिसे कठिन गिनती याद करती है。

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers without overreacting
segments.tr: ## अति प्रतिक्रिया किए बिना नंबरों को कैसे पढ़ें

segments.src: - **Look at trends, not single weeks.** Weekly claims are noisy. Holidays, seasonal patterns, and local events such as weather or a plant closure can shift a single reading. A four-week average smooths some of this out.
segments.tr: - ** रुझानों को देखें, एक सप्ताह को नहीं।** साप्ताहिक दावे शोरगुल वाले हैं। छुट्टियां, मौसमी पैटर्न, और स्थानीय घटनाएं जैसे मौसम या प्लांट बंद होना एक ही रीडिंग को बदल सकते हैं। चार सप्ताह का औसत इसमें से कुछ को चिकना कर देता है।

segments.src: - **Compare across indicators.** If claims are low but hires and quits are also low, the market is probably stable but stagnant, not strong.

segments.src: - **Expect revisions.** Many labor statistics are revised after first publication, and the story can change.
segments.tr: - **संशोधनों की अपेक्षा करें।** कई श्रम आंकड़ों को पहली बार प्रकाशित होने के बाद संशोधित किया जाता है, और कहानी बदल सकती है。

segments.src: ## What this means for job seekers and workers

segments.tr: - उन क्षेत्रों और क्षेत्रों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करें जहाँ भर्ती डेटा वास्तविक गतिविधि दिखाता है।

segments.src: ## What jobless claims actually measure
segments.tr: ## Ce que mesurent réellement les demandes d'indemnisation chômage

segments.src: Initial jobless claims count the number of people who file for unemployment insurance benefits for the first time in a given week.
segments.tr: Les demandes initiales d'indemnisation chômage comptabilisent le nombre de personnes qui demandent des prestations d'assurance-chômage pour la première fois au cours d'une semaine donnée.

segments.src: A low claims number therefore means that few people are being pushed out of jobs.

segments.src: ## Why layoffs and hiring can diverge
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les licenciements et l'embauche peuvent diverger

segments.src: ### Employers are holding on to workers
segments.tr: ### Les employeurs s'accrochent à leurs salariés

segments.src: After the staffing shortages of recent years, many employers became wary of letting people go.
segments.tr: Après les pénuries de personnel de ces dernières années, de nombreux employeurs sont devenus réticents à l'idée de licencier.

segments.src: Recruiting and training are expensive, and companies that struggled to fill roles may prefer to keep existing staff even when demand softens.
segments.tr: Le recrutement et la formation coûtent cher, et les entreprises qui ont eu du mal à pourvoir des postes peuvent préférer conserver leur personnel actuel même lorsque la demande faiblit.

segments.src: That keeps layoffs low.
segments.tr: Cela maintient les licenciements à un niveau bas.

segments.src: ### Caution slows hiring at the same time
segments.tr: ### La prudence ralentit l'embauche en même temps

segments.src: The same caution that discourages layoffs can discourage new hiring.
segments.tr: La même prudence qui décourage les licenciements peut décourager les nouvelles embauches.

segments.src: When businesses are unsure about interest rates, costs, or future demand, a common response is to freeze headcount: don't cut, but don't add.
segments.tr: Lorsque les entreprises sont incertaines quant aux taux d'intérêt, aux coûts ou à la demande future, une réponse courante est de geler les effectifs : ne pas couper, mais ne pas ajouter.

segments.src: The result is a market with little churn.
segments.tr: Il en résulte un marché avec peu de mouvements.

segments.src: ### A "low-hire, low-fire" market
segments.tr: ### Un marché "faible embauche, faible licenciement"

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a low-hire, low-fire labor market.
segments.tr: Les économistes décrivent souvent ce schéma comme un marché du travail à faible embauche et faible licenciement.

segments.src: Workers who have jobs tend to feel relatively secure.
segments.tr: Les travailleurs qui ont un emploi ont tendance à se sentir relativement en sécurité.

segments.src: Workers who are looking for jobs, or who want to switch, find fewer chances.
segments.tr: Les travailleurs qui cherchent un emploi, ou qui veulent changer, trouvent moins d'opportunités.

segments.src: Because people change jobs less often, fewer openings are created by turnover, which makes the search feel harder even when layoffs are rare.
segments.tr: Parce que les gens changent d'emploi moins souvent, moins d'ouvertures sont créées par le renouvellement, ce qui rend la recherche plus difficile même lorsque les licenciements sont rares.

segments.src: ### The experience is uneven
segments.tr: ### L'expérience est inégale

segments.src: National averages can hide big differences.
segments.tr: Les moyennes nationales peuvent masquer de grandes différences.

segments.src: Some industries and regions hire steadily while others are cutting back.
segments.tr: Certaines industries et régions embauchent régulièrement tandis que d'autres réduisent la voilure.

segments.src: Entry-level applicants, people changing careers, and workers in fields with heavy automation or restructuring may have a very different experience than the headline numbers suggest.
segments.tr: Les candidats débutants, les personnes en reconversion professionnelle et les travailleurs dans des domaines soumis à une forte automatisation ou restructuration peuvent vivre une expérience très différente de ce que suggèrent les chiffres globaux.

segments.src: ## Indicators that give a fuller picture
segments.tr: ## Les indicateurs qui donnent une image plus complète

segments.src: No single statistic captures a labor market.
segments.tr: Aucune statistique unique ne capture un marché du travail.

segments.src: These are commonly used alongside jobless claims:
segments.tr: Ceux-ci sont couramment utilisés aux côtés des demandes d'indemnisation chômage :

segments.src: 1. **Continuing claims.** This measures people who are still receiving benefits after an initial claim. When continuing claims rise while initial claims stay low, it can mean laid-off workers are taking longer to find new jobs.
segments.tr: 1. **Demandes continues.** Cela mesure les personnes qui reçoivent toujours des prestations après une demande initiale. Lorsque les demandes continues augmentent alors que les demandes initiales restent basses, cela peut signifier que les travailleurs licenciés mettent plus de temps à retrouver un emploi.

segments.src: 2. **Job openings and labor turnover (JOLTS).** The Bureau of Labor Statistics survey reports openings, hires, quits, and layoffs. The *hires rate* and the *quits rate* are especially useful for judging how dynamic the market is.
segments.tr: 2. **Offres d'emploi et rotation de la main-d'œuvre (JOLTS).** L'enquête du Bureau of Labor Statistics rapporte les offres, les embauches, les démissions et les licenciements. Le *taux d'embauche* et le *taux de démission* sont particulièrement utiles pour juger du dynamisme du marché.

segments.src: 3. **Monthly payroll employment.** The jobs report shows net job growth. Pay attention to revisions, since early estimates are often adjusted later.
segments.tr: 3. **Emploi salarié mensuel.** Le rapport sur l'emploi montre la croissance nette de l'emploi. Prêtez attention aux révisions, car les premières estimations sont souvent ajustées par la suite.

segments.src: 4. **The unemployment rate and its duration breakdown.** A rising share of long-term unemployed workers suggests that finding work is getting harder, even if the overall rate looks stable.
segments.tr: 4. **Le taux de chômage et sa ventilation par durée.** Une part croissante de chômeurs de longue durée suggère qu'il devient plus difficile de trouver du travail, même si le taux global semble stable.

segments.src: 5. **Labor force participation and the employment-population ratio.** These show whether people are working or looking, or have stepped away from the market.
segments.tr: 5. **La participation au marché du travail et le ratio emploi-population.** Ceux-ci montrent si les gens travaillent, cherchent un emploi ou se sont retirés du marché.

segments.src: 6. **Wage growth.** Measures such as the Employment Cost Index and average hourly earnings indicate whether employers are competing for workers.
segments.tr: 6. **La croissance des salaires.** Des mesures telles que l'indice du coût de l'emploi et le gain horaire moyen indiquent si les employeurs se disputent les travailleurs.

segments.src: 7. **Surveys of workers and employers.** Consumer confidence surveys often ask whether jobs are "plentiful" or "hard to get," and business surveys ask about hiring plans. These capture sentiment that hard counts miss.
segments.tr: 7. **Les enquêtes auprès des travailleurs et des employeurs.** Les enquêtes de confiance des consommateurs demandent souvent si les emplois sont "abondants" ou "diffibles à obtenir", et les enquêtes auprès des entreprises interrogent sur les plans d'embauche. Celles-ci captent un sentiment que les comptes bruts ratent.

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers without overreacting
segments.tr: ## Comment lire les chiffres sans surréagir

segments.src: - **Look at trends, not single weeks.** Weekly claims are noisy. Holidays, seasonal patterns, and local events such as weather or a plant closure can shift a single reading. A four-week average smooths some of this out.
segments.tr: - **Regardez les tendances, pas les semaines isolées.** Les demandes hebdomadaires sont volatiles. Les vacances, les schémas saisonniers et les événements locaux tels que la météo ou la fermeture d'une usine peuvent modifier une seule lecture. Une moyenne sur quatre semaines permet d'atténuer cela.

segments.src: - **Compare across indicators.** If claims are low but hires and quits are also low, the market is probably stable but stagnant, not strong.
segments.tr: - **Comparez entre les indicateurs.** Si les demandes sont basses mais que les embauches et les démissions le sont aussi, le marché est probablement stable mais stagnant, pas fort.

segments.src: - **Remember that "low" is relative.** The labor force is much larger than in past decades, so a low count of claims should be viewed alongside the size of the workforce.
segments.tr: - **N'oubliez pas que "bas" est relatif.** La population active est beaucoup plus importante que lors des décennies passées, donc un nombre faible de demandes doit être examiné conjointement avec la taille de la main-d'œuvre.

segments.src: - **Expect revisions.** Many labor statistics are revised after first publication, and the story can change.
segments.tr: - **Attendez-vous à des révisions.** De nombreuses statistiques du travail sont révisées après leur première publication, et l'histoire peut changer.

segments.src: ## What this means for job seekers and workers
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les demandeurs d'emploi et les travailleurs

segments.src: Low layoffs are good news for people who are currently employed, but they do not guarantee that the search for a new role will be quick.
segments.tr: Des licenciements bas sont une bonne nouvelle pour les personnes actuellement employées, mais ils ne garantissent pas que la recherche d'un nouveau rôle sera rapide.

segments.src: If you are looking for work, some practical steps may help:
segments.tr: Si vous cherchez du travail, quelques étapes pratiques peuvent vous aider :

segments.src: - Focus on sectors and regions where hiring data shows real activity.
segments.tr: - Concentrez-vous sur les secteurs et les régions où les données d'embauche montrent une réelle activité.

segments.src: - Expect longer timelines and plan your finances accordingly.
segments.tr: - Attendez-vous à des délais plus longs et planifiez vos finances en conséquence.

segments.src: - Keep skills and professional networks current, since many openings are filled through referrals.
segments.tr: - Maintenez vos compétences et vos réseaux professionnels à jour, car de nombreux postes sont pourvus par cooptation.

segments.src: - Consider the full compensation picture, not just the headline salary, when weighing offers.
segments.tr: - Considérez la rémunération globale, et pas seulement le salaire brut, lorsque vous pesez des offres.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: Jobless claims are a useful early warning for layoffs, and a very low reading signals that employers are not shedding workers in large numbers.
segments.tr: Les demandes d'indemnisation chômage constituent un avertissement précoce utile en cas de licenciements, et un niveau très bas signale que les employeurs ne se séparent pas de leurs salariés en masse.

segments.src: But a healthy-looking claims figure and a sluggish hiring environment are not contradictory.
segments.tr: Mais un chiffre des demandes d'apparence saine et un environnement d'embauche apathique ne sont pas contradictoires.

segments.src: To judge how the job market is really doing, look at claims together with hires, quits, openings, duration of unemployment, and wage trends.
segments.tr: Pour juger de la santé réelle du marché du travail, observez les demandes en même temps que les embauches, les démissions, les offres, la durée du chômage et les tendances salariales.

segments.src: Yet many job seekers describe a market that feels slow: fewer openings, longer searches, and more rounds of interviews.

segments.src: ## What jobless claims actually measure
segments.tr: ## Apa yang sebenarnya diukur oleh klaim pengangguran

segments.src: Initial jobless claims count the number of people who file for unemployment insurance benefits for the first time in a given week.
segments.tr: Klaim pengangguran awal menghitung jumlah orang yang mengajukan tunjangan asuransi pengangguran untuk pertama kalinya dalam minggu tertentu.

segments.src: The figure is published weekly by the U.S.

segments.src: That speed is its strength.
segments.tr: Kecepatan itulah kekuatannya.

segments.src: It is also its limit.
segments.tr: Itu juga batasannya.

segments.src: Claims capture **layoffs**, meaning people who lose a job and apply for benefits.
segments.tr: Klaim menangkap **PHK**, yang berarti orang yang kehilangan pekerjaan dan mengajukan tunjangan.

segments.src: They say very little about:
segments.tr: Klaim tersebut tidak banyak menceritakan tentang:

segments.src: - **Hiring**: how many people are being brought on.
segments.tr: - **Perekrutan**: berapa banyak orang yang dipekerjakan.

segments.src: - **Quits**: workers who leave voluntarily and generally do not qualify for benefits.
segments.tr: - **Pengunduran diri**: pekerja yang keluar secara sukarela dan umumnya tidak memenuhi syarat untuk tunjangan.

segments.src: - **New entrants and re-entrants**: graduates, caregivers returning to work, or others who have not recently held a covered job.
segments.tr: - **Pendatang baru dan peminat lama yang kembali**: lulusan, pengasuh yang kembali bekerja, atau pihak lain yang belum lama ini memegang pekerjaan yang dilindungi.

segments.src: - **Eligibility gaps**: some workers do not qualify for benefits, and some who qualify never file.
segments.tr: - **Kesenjangan kelayakan**: beberapa pekerja tidak memenuhi syarat untuk tunjangan, dan beberapa yang memenuhi syarat tidak pernah mengajukan.

segments.src: A low claims number therefore means that few people are being pushed out of jobs.
segments.tr: Oleh karena itu, angka klaim yang rendah berarti sedikit orang yang dikeluarkan dari pekerjaan.

segments.src: It does not mean many people are being pulled into new ones.
segments.tr: Itu tidak berarti banyak orang yang ditarik ke dalam pekerjaan baru.

segments.src: ## Why layoffs and hiring can diverge
segments.tr: ## Mengapa PHK dan perekrutan dapat menyimpang

segments.src: ### Employers are holding on to workers
segments.tr: ### Pemberi kerja mempertahankan para pekerja

segments.src: After the staffing shortages of recent years, many employers became wary of letting people go.
segments.tr: Setelah kekurangan staf dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, banyak pemberi kerja menjadi waspada untuk melepaskan orang.

segments.src: Recruiting and training are expensive, and companies that struggled to fill roles may prefer to keep existing staff even when demand softens.
segments.tr: Perekrutan dan pelatihan itu mahal, dan perusahaan yang kesulitan mengisi peran mungkin lebih memilih untuk mempertahankan staf yang ada bahkan ketika permintaan melunak.

segments.src: That keeps layoffs low.

segments.src: ### Caution slows hiring at the same time

segments.src: The same caution that discourages layoffs can discourage new hiring.

segments.src: When businesses are unsure about interest rates, costs, or future demand, a common response is to freeze headcount: don't cut, but don't add.

segments.src: The result is a market with little churn.
segments.tr: Hasilnya adalah pasar dengan sedikit perputaran.

segments.src: ### A "low-hire, low-fire" market
segments.tr: ### Pasar "sedikit perekrutan, sedikit pemecatan"

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a low-hire, low-fire labor market.
segments.tr: Para ekonom sering menggambarkan pola ini sebagai pasar tenaga kerja yang sedikit merekrut dan sedikit memecat.

segments.src: Workers who have jobs tend to feel relatively secure.

segments.src: Workers who are looking for jobs, or who want to switch, find fewer chances.
segments.tr: Pekerja yang mencari pekerjaan, atau yang ingin beralih, menemukan lebih sedikit peluang.

segments.src: Because people change jobs less often, fewer openings are created by turnover, which makes the search feel harder even when layoffs are rare.
segments.tr: Karena orang lebih jarang berganti pekerjaan, lebih sedikit lowongan yang tercipta dari perputaran, yang membuat pencarian terasa lebih sulit bahkan ketika PHK jarang terjadi.

segments.src: ### The experience is uneven

segments.src: National averages can hide big differences.
segments.tr: Rata-rata nasional dapat menyembunyikan perbedaan besar.

segments.src: Some industries and regions hire steadily while others are cutting back.

segments.tr: Pelamar tingkat pemula, orang yang berganti karier, dan pekerja di bidang dengan otomatisasi atau restrukturisasi yang berat mungkin memiliki pengalaman yang sangat berbeda dari yang disarankan oleh angka utama.

segments.src: ## Indicators that give a fuller picture
segments.tr: ## Indikator yang memberikan gambaran lebih utuh

segments.src: No single statistic captures a labor market.
segments.tr: Tidak ada satu statistik pun yang menangkap pasar tenaga kerja.

segments.src: These are commonly used alongside jobless claims:
segments.tr: Ini adalah hal-hal yang biasa digunakan bersamaan dengan klaim pengangguran:

segments.src: 1. **Continuing claims.** This measures people who are still receiving benefits after an initial claim. When continuing claims rise while initial claims stay low, it can mean laid-off workers are taking longer to find new jobs.
segments.tr: 1. **Klaim lanjutan.** Ini mengukur orang yang masih menerima tunjangan setelah klaim awal. Ketika klaim lanjutan meningkat sementara klaim awal tetap rendah, itu bisa berarti pekerja yang di-PHK membutuhkan waktu lebih lama untuk menemukan pekerjaan baru.

segments.src: 2. **Job openings and labor turnover (JOLTS).** The Bureau of Labor Statistics survey reports openings, hires, quits, and layoffs. The *hires rate* and the *quits rate* are especially useful for judging how dynamic the market is.
segments.tr: 2. **Lowongan pekerjaan dan perputaran tenaga kerja (JOLTS).** Survei Biro Statistik Tenaga Kerja melaporkan lowongan, perekrutan, pengunduran diri, dan PHK. *Tingkat perekrutan* dan *tingkat pengunduran diri* sangat berguna untuk menilai seberapa dinamis pasar tersebut.

segments.src: 3. **Monthly payroll employment.** The jobs report shows net job growth. Pay attention to revisions, since early estimates are often adjusted later.
segments.tr: 3. **Pekerjaan penggajian bulanan.** Laporan pekerjaan menunjukkan pertumbuhan pekerjaan bersih. Perhatikan revisi, karena perkiraan awal sering kali disesuaikan kemudian.

segments.src: 4. **The unemployment rate and its duration breakdown.** A rising share of long-term unemployed workers suggests that finding work is getting harder, even if the overall rate looks stable.
segments.tr: 4. **Tingkat pengangguran dan rincian durasinya.** Porsi pekerja pengangguran jangka panjang yang meningkat menunjukkan bahwa menemukan pekerjaan semakin sulit, bahkan jika tingkat keseluruhan terlihat stabil.

segments.src: 5. **Labor force participation and the employment-population ratio.** These show whether people are working or looking, or have stepped away from the market.
segments.tr: 5. **Partisipasi angkatan kerja dan rasio pekerjaan-penduduk.** Ini menunjukkan apakah orang bekerja atau mencari, atau telah menjauh dari pasar.

segments.src: 6. **Wage growth.** Measures such as the Employment Cost Index and average hourly earnings indicate whether employers are competing for workers.
segments.tr: 6. **Pertumbuhan upah.** Ukuran seperti Indeks Biaya Ketenagakerjaan dan pendapatan per jam rata-rata menunjukkan apakah pemberi kerja bersaing untuk mendapatkan pekerja.

segments.src: 7. **Surveys of workers and employers.** Consumer confidence surveys often ask whether jobs are "plentiful" or "hard to get," and business surveys ask about hiring plans. These capture sentiment that hard counts miss.
segments.tr: 7. **Survei pekerja dan pemberi kerja.** Survei keyakinan konsumen sering kali menanyakan apakah pekerjaan "berlimpah" atau "sulit didapat," dan survei bisnis menanyakan tentang rencana perekrutan. Ini menangkap sentimen yang dilewatkan oleh hitungan keras.

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers without overreacting
segments.tr: ## Cara membaca angka tanpa bereaksi berlebihan

segments.src: - **Look at trends, not single weeks.** Weekly claims are noisy. Holidays, seasonal patterns, and local events such as weather or a plant closure can shift a single reading. A four-week average smooths some of this out.
segments.tr: - **Lihat tren, bukan minggu tunggal.** Klaim mingguan itu bising. Hari libur, pola musiman, dan peristiwa lokal seperti cuaca atau penutupan pabrik dapat mengubah satu pembacaan. Rata-rata empat minggu menghaluskan beberapa di antaranya.

segments.src: - **Compare across indicators.** If claims are low but hires and quits are also low, the market is probably stable but stagnant, not strong.
segments.tr: - **Bandingkan lintas indikator.** Jika klaim rendah tetapi perekrutan dan pengunduran diri juga rendah, pasar mungkin stabil tetapi stagnan, bukan kuat.

segments.src: - **Remember that "low" is relative.** The labor force is much larger than in past decades, so a low count of claims should be viewed alongside the size of the workforce.
segments.tr: - **Ingat bahwa "rendah" itu relatif.** Angkatan kerja jauh lebih besar daripada dekade-dekade sebelumnya, jadi jumlah klaim yang rendah harus dilihat bersamaan dengan ukuran angkatan kerja.

segments.src: - **Expect revisions.** Many labor statistics are revised after first publication, and the story can change.
segments.tr: - **Harapkan revisi.** Banyak statistik tenaga kerja direvisi setelah publikasi pertama, dan ceritanya dapat berubah.

segments.src: ## What this means for job seekers and workers
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya ini bagi pencari kerja dan pekerja

segments.src: Low layoffs are good news for people who are currently employed, but they do not guarantee that the search for a new role will be quick.
segments.tr: PHK yang rendah adalah berita bagus bagi orang yang saat ini bekerja, tetapi itu tidak menjamin bahwa pencarian peran baru akan cepat.

segments.src: If you are looking for work, some practical steps may help:

segments.src: - Focus on sectors and regions where hiring data shows real activity.
segments.tr: - Fokus pada sektor dan wilayah di mana data perekrutan menunjukkan aktivitas nyata.

segments.src: - Expect longer timelines and plan your finances accordingly.

segments.src: - Keep skills and professional networks current, since many openings are filled through referrals.

segments.src: - Consider the full compensation picture, not just the headline salary, when weighing offers.

segments.src: ## The bottom line

segments.src: Department of Labor, which makes it one of the fastest-moving signals about the labor market.
segments.tr: 労働省によって毎週発表されており、労働市場に関する最も動きの早いシグマルのひとつとなっています。

segments.src: That speed is its strength.
segments.tr: その速さが強みです。

segments.src: It is also its limit.
segments.tr: 同時に、それが限界でもあります。

segments.src: Claims capture **layoffs**, meaning people who lose a job and apply for benefits.
segments.tr: 申請件数が捉えるのは**解雇**、つまり仕事を失い給付を申請する人々です。

segments.src: They say very little about:
segments.tr: これらは以下のことについてはほとんど語りません。

segments.src: - **Hiring**: how many people are being brought on.
segments.tr: - **採用**: どれだけの人が新たに迎え入れられているか。

segments.src: - **Quits**: workers who leave voluntarily and generally do not qualify for benefits.
segments.tr: - **自主退職**: 自発的に辞め、通常は給付の対象外となる労働者。

segments.src: - **New entrants and re-entrants**: graduates, caregivers returning to work, or others who have not recently held a covered job.
segments.tr: - **新規参入者と再参入者**: 卒業生、仕事に復帰する介護者、または最近対象となる仕事に就いていなかったその他の人々。

segments.src: - **Eligibility gaps**: some workers do not qualify for benefits, and some who qualify never file.
segments.tr: - **受給資格のギャップ**: 給付の対象外となる労働者や、対象でありながら申請しない人々。

segments.src: A low claims number therefore means that few people are being pushed out of jobs.
segments.tr: したがって、申請件数が低いということは、仕事を追われる人が少ないことを意味します。

segments.src: It does not mean many people are being pulled into new ones.
segments.tr: 多くの人が新しい仕事に呼び込まれていることを意味するわけではありません。

segments.src: ## Why layoffs and hiring can diverge
segments.tr: ## 解雇と採用が乖離する理由

segments.src: ### Employers are holding on to workers
segments.tr: ### 雇用主が労働者を手放さずにいる

segments.src: After the staffing shortages of recent years, many employers became wary of letting people go.
segments.tr: ここ数年の人手不足の後、多くの雇用主は人員削減に慎重になりました。

segments.src: Recruiting and training are expensive, and companies that struggled to fill roles may prefer to keep existing staff even when demand softens.
segments.tr: 採用とトレーニングにはコストがかかり、人員補充に苦労した企業は、需要が軟化した場合でも既存のスタッフを維持することを好む傾向があります。

segments.src: That keeps layoffs low.
segments.tr: それが解雇を低く抑えています。

segments.src: ### Caution slows hiring at the same time
segments.tr: ### 慎重さが同時に採用を鈍らせる

segments.src: The same caution that discourages layoffs can discourage new hiring.
segments.tr: 解雇を思いとどまらせるのと同じ慎重さが、新規採用をも躊躇させることがあります。

segments.src: When businesses are unsure about interest rates, costs, or future demand, a common response is to freeze headcount: don't cut, but don't add.
segments.tr: 企業が金利、コスト、将来の需要について確信を持てない場合、一般的な対応は人員の凍結です。つまり、削減はしないが追加もしないということです。

segments.src: The result is a market with little churn.
segments.tr: その結果、流動性の低い市場が生まれます。

segments.src: ### A "low-hire, low-fire" market
segments.tr: ### 「採用少なく、解雇少ない」市場

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a low-hire, low-fire labor market.
segments.tr: エコノミストは、この傾向を「採用少なく、解雇少ない」労働市場と表現することがよくあります。

segments.src: Workers who have jobs tend to feel relatively secure.
segments.tr: すでに仕事を持っている労働者は、比較的安定していると感じる傾向があります。

segments.src: Workers who are looking for jobs, or who want to switch, find fewer chances.
segments.tr: 仕事を探している労働者や、転職したいと考えている労働者にとっては、チャンスが少なくなります。

segments.src: Because people change jobs less often, fewer openings are created by turnover, which makes the search feel harder even when layoffs are rare.
segments.tr: 人々が転職する頻度が低いため、離職によって生まれる求人が減り、解雇がまれであっても求職活動がより困難に感じられます。

segments.src: ### The experience is uneven
segments.tr: ### 経験には偏りがある

segments.src: National averages can hide big differences.
segments.tr: 全国平均は大きな違いを隠してします。

segments.src: Some industries and regions hire steadily while others are cutting back.
segments.tr: 一部の業界や地域では着実に採用が行われている一方で、他の業界や地域では削減が進んでいます。

segments.src: Entry-level applicants, people changing careers, and workers in fields with heavy automation or restructuring may have a very different experience than the headline numbers suggest.
segments.tr: 新卒の応募者、キャリアチェンジをする人、自動化や組織再編が激しい分野の労働者は、ヘッドラインの数値が示唆するものとはまったく異なる経験をしている可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Indicators that give a fuller picture
segments.tr: ## より完全な全体像を提供する指標

segments.src: No single statistic captures a labor market.
segments.tr: 単一の統計だけで労働市場を捉えることはできません。

segments.src: These are commonly used alongside jobless claims:
segments.tr: これらは通常、失業保険申請件数と併せて使用されます。

segments.src: 1. **Continuing claims.** This measures people who are still receiving benefits after an initial claim. When continuing claims rise while initial claims stay low, it can mean laid-off workers are taking longer to find new jobs.
segments.tr: 1. **継続受給申請件数。** これは、最初の申請後に引き続き給付を受けている人々を測定します。初期申請件数が低いままで継続受給申請件数が増加する場合、解雇された労働者が新しい仕事を見つけるのに時間がかかっていることを意味する可能性があります。

segments.src: 2. **Job openings and labor turnover (JOLTS).** The Bureau of Labor Statistics survey reports openings, hires, quits, and layoffs. The *hires rate* and the *quits rate* are especially useful for judging how dynamic the market is.
segments.tr: 2. **求人および労働異動調査（JOLTS）。** 労働統計局の調査は、求人、採用、自主退職、解雇を報告しています。*採用率*と*自主退職率*は、市場のダイナミックさを判断する上で特に役立ちます。

segments.src: 3. **Monthly payroll employment.** The jobs report shows net job growth. Pay attention to revisions, since early estimates are often adjusted later.
segments.tr: 3. **月次非農業部門雇用者数。** 雇用レポートは純雇用増加数を示しています。早期の推定値は後で調整されることが多いため、改定に注意してください。

segments.src: 4. **The unemployment rate and its duration breakdown.** A rising share of long-term unemployed workers suggests that finding work is getting harder, even if the overall rate looks stable.
segments.tr: 4. **失業率とその期間別内訳。** 長期失業者の割合が増加していることは、全体的な率が安定しているように見えても、仕事を見つけることが難しくなっていることを示唆しています。

segments.src: 5. **Labor force participation and the employment-population ratio.** These show whether people are working or looking, or have stepped away from the market.
segments.tr: 5. **労働力参加率と雇用人口比率。** これらは、人々が働いているか探しているか、あるいは市場から離れているかを示しています。

segments.src: 6. **Wage growth.** Measures such as the Employment Cost Index and average hourly earnings indicate whether employers are competing for workers.
segments.tr: 6. **賃金上昇率。** 雇用コスト指数や平均時給などの指標は、雇用主が労働者を求めて競争しているかどうかを示しています。

segments.src: 7. **Surveys of workers and employers.** Consumer confidence surveys often ask whether jobs are "plentiful" or "hard to get," and business surveys ask about hiring plans. These capture sentiment that hard counts miss.
segments.tr: 7. **労働者と雇用主への調査。** 消費者信頼感調査では、仕事が「豊富」か「見つけにくい」かを尋ねることが多く、企業調査では採用計画について尋ねます。これらは、ハードカウントでは見落とされるセンチメントを捉えます。

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers without overreacting
segments.tr: ## 過剰反応せずに数字を読み解く方法

segments.src: - **Look at trends, not single weeks.** Weekly claims are noisy. Holidays, seasonal patterns, and local events such as weather or a plant closure can shift a single reading. A four-week average smooths some of this out.
segments.tr: - **単一の週ではなく、トレンドを見る。** 週ごとの申請件数はノイズが多いです。祝日、季節的なパターン、天候や工場閉鎖などの地域的なイベントが、単一の読み取り値を変化させることがあります。4週間の平均値は、これらの一部を滑らかにします。

segments.src: - **Compare across indicators.** If claims are low but hires and quits are also low, the market is probably stable but stagnant, not strong.
segments.tr: - **指標間で比較する。** 申請件数が少なくても、採用や自主退職も少ない場合、市場はおそらく安定しているものの停滞しており、強いわけではありません。

segments.src: - **Remember that "low" is relative.** The labor force is much larger than in past decades, so a low count of claims should be viewed alongside the size of the workforce.
segments.tr: - **「低い」ということは相対的であることを忘れない。** 労働力は過去の数十年よりもはるかに大きいため、申請件数の少なさは労働力の規模と併せて見る必要があります。

segments.src: - **Expect revisions.** Many labor statistics are revised after first publication, and the story can change.
segments.tr: - **改定を予想する。** 多くの労働統計は最初の発表後に改定され、ストーリーが変わることがあります。

segments.src: ## What this means for job seekers and workers
segments.tr: ## これが求職者や労働者にとって意味すること

segments.src: Low layoffs are good news for people who are currently employed, but they do not guarantee that the search for a new role will be quick.
segments.tr: 低い解雇率は現在雇用されている人にとって朗報ですが、新しい役割の探求が迅速に行われることを保証するものではありません。

segments.src: If you are looking for work, some practical steps may help:
segments.tr: 仕事を探している場合、いくつかの実用的なステップが役立つかもしれません。

segments.src: - Focus on sectors and regions where hiring data shows real activity.
segments.tr: - 採用データが実際の活動を示している分野や地域に焦点を当てる。

segments.src: - Expect longer timelines and plan your finances accordingly.
segments.tr: - より長いタイムラインを想定し、それに応じて財務を計画する。

segments.src: - Keep skills and professional networks current, since many openings are filled through referrals.
segments.tr: - 多くの求人が紹介を通じて埋められるため、スキルとプロフェッショナルネットワークを最新の状態に保つ。

segments.src: - Consider the full compensation picture, not just the headline salary, when weighing offers.
segments.tr: - オファーを比較検討する際は、ヘッドラインの給与だけでなく、総合的な報酬の全体像を考慮する。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: Jobless claims are a useful early warning for layoffs, and a very low reading signals that employers are not shedding workers in large numbers.
segments.tr: 失業保険申請件数は解雇に対する有用な早期警戒であり、非常に低い数値は雇用主が大量に労働者を手放していないことを示しています。

segments.src: But a healthy-looking claims figure and a sluggish hiring environment are not contradictory.
segments.tr: しかし、健康的に見える申請件数の数値と、低調な採用環境は矛盾するものではありません。

segments.src: To judge how the job market is really doing, look at claims together with hires, quits, openings, duration of unemployment, and wage trends.
segments.tr: 労働市場が実際にどうなっているかを判断するには、申請件数を採用、自主退職、求人、失業期間、賃金動向とともに確認してください。

segments.src: Weekly jobless claims have recently sat near the lowest levels seen in decades.
segments.tr: Wöchentliche Erstanträge auf Arbeitslosenhilfe bewegen sich seit Kurzem auf dem niedrigsten Stand seit Jahrzehnten.

segments.src: Yet many job seekers describe a market that feels slow: fewer openings, longer searches, and more rounds of interviews.

segments.src: This article explains why the layoff data and the hiring data can point in different directions, and which indicators help fill in the rest of the picture.
segments.tr: Dieser Artikel erklärt, warum die Entlassungs- und die Einstellungsdaten in unterschiedliche Richtungen weisen können und welche Indikatoren dabei helfen, das restliche Bild zu vervollständigen.

segments.src: ## What jobless claims actually measure
segments.tr: ## Was Arbeitslosenanträge tatsächlich messen

segments.src: Initial jobless claims count the number of people who file for unemployment insurance benefits for the first time in a given week.
segments.tr: Erstanträge auf Arbeitslosenhilfe zählen die Anzahl der Personen, die in einer bestimmten Woche zum ersten Mal Versicherungsleistungen bei Arbeitslosigkeit beantragen.

segments.src: The figure is published weekly by the U.S.
segments.tr: Die Zahl wird wöchentlich von der US-amerikanischen

segments.src: Department of Labor, which makes it one of the fastest-moving signals about the labor market.
segments.tr: Arbeitsbehörde (Department of Labor) veröffentlicht, was sie zu einem der am schnellsten reagierenden Signale über den Arbeitsmarkt macht.

segments.src: That speed is its strength.
segments.tr: Diese Schnelligkeit ist ihre Stärke.

segments.src: It is also its limit.
segments.tr: Sie ist zugleich ihre Grenze.

segments.src: Claims capture **layoffs**, meaning people who lose a job and apply for benefits.
segments.tr: Anträge erfassen **Entlassungen** (Layoffs), das heißt Personen, die ihren Arbeitsplatz verlieren und Leistungen beantragen.

segments.src: They say very little about:

segments.src: - **Hiring**: how many people are being brought on.
segments.tr: - **Einstellungen** (Hiring): Wie viele Personen neu eingestellt werden.

segments.src: - **Quits**: workers who leave voluntarily and generally do not qualify for benefits.
segments.tr: - **Kündigungen durch Arbeitnehmer** (Quits): Arbeitskräfte, die freiwillig ausscheiden und im Allgemeinen keinen Anspruch auf Leistungen haben.

segments.src: - **New entrants and re-entrants**: graduates, caregivers returning to work, or others who have not recently held a covered job.
segments.tr: - **Neueinsteiger und Wiedereinsteiger**: Absolventen, pflegende Angehörige, die in die Arbeit zurückkehren, oder andere, die kürzlich keinen versicherungspflichtigen Arbeitsplatz innehatten.

segments.src: - **Eligibility gaps**: some workers do not qualify for benefits, and some who qualify never file.
segments.tr: - **Berechtigungslücken**: Einige Arbeitnehmer haben keinen Anspruch auf Leistungen, und manche Berechtigte stellen niemals einen Antrag.

segments.src: A low claims number therefore means that few people are being pushed out of jobs.
segments.tr: Eine niedrige Antragszahl bedeutet daher, dass nur wenige Menschen aus Jobs gedrängt werden.

segments.src: It does not mean many people are being pulled into new ones.
segments.tr: Sie bedeutet nicht, dass viele Menschen in neue Jobs gezogen werden.

segments.src: ## Why layoffs and hiring can diverge
segments.tr: ## Warum Entlassungen und Einstellungen auseinanderdriften können

segments.src: ### Employers are holding on to workers
segments.tr: ### Arbeitgeber halten an Arbeitskräften fest

segments.src: After the staffing shortages of recent years, many employers became wary of letting people go.
segments.tr: Nach den Personalengpässen der letzten Jahre wurden viele Arbeitgeber vorsichtig, was das Entlassen von Personen angeht.

segments.src: Recruiting and training are expensive, and companies that struggled to fill roles may prefer to keep existing staff even when demand softens.
segments.tr: Rekrutierung und Schulung sind teuer, und Unternehmen, die Mühe hatten, Rollen zu besetzen, ziehen es möglicherweise vor, das bestehende Personal zu behalten, selbst wenn die Nachfrage schwächer wird.

segments.src: That keeps layoffs low.
segments.tr: Das hält Entlassungen niedrig.

segments.src: ### Caution slows hiring at the same time
segments.tr: ### Vorsicht bremst gleichzeitig die Einstellungen

segments.src: The same caution that discourages layoffs can discourage new hiring.

segments.src: When businesses are unsure about interest rates, costs, or future demand, a common response is to freeze headcount: don't cut, but don't add.
segments.tr: Wenn Unternehmen unsicher bezüglich Zinssätzen, Kosten oder der zukünftigen Nachfrage sind, ist eine übliche Reaktion ein Einstellungsstopp: nicht kürzen, aber auch nicht hinzufügen.

segments.src: The result is a market with little churn.

segments.src: ### A "low-hire, low-fire" market
segments.tr: ### Ein „wenig einstellender, wenig entlassender“ Markt

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a low-hire, low-fire labor market.
segments.tr: Ökonomen beschreiben dieses Muster oft als einen Arbeitsmarkt mit wenig Einstellungen und wenigen Entlassungen.

segments.src: Workers who have jobs tend to feel relatively secure.

segments.src: Workers who are looking for jobs, or who want to switch, find fewer chances.
segments.tr: Arbeitnehmer, die nach Arbeit suchen oder wechseln möchten, finden weniger Chancen.

segments.src: Because people change jobs less often, fewer openings are created by turnover, which makes the search feel harder even when layoffs are rare.

segments.src: ### The experience is uneven
segments.tr: ### Die Erfahrung ist ungleichmäßig

segments.src: National averages can hide big differences.
segments.tr: Nationale Durchschnitte können große Unterschiede verbergen.

segments.src: Some industries and regions hire steadily while others are cutting back.
segments.tr: Einige Branchen und Regionen stellen konstant ein, während andere zurückschrauben.

segments.src: Entry-level applicants, people changing careers, and workers in fields with heavy automation or restructuring may have a very different experience than the headline numbers suggest.
segments.tr: Berufseinsteiger, Personen, die ihre Karriere wechseln, und Arbeitskräfte in Bereichen mit starker Automatisierung oder Umstrukturierung machen möglicherweise ganz andere Erfahrungen, als die Schlagzeilenzahlen nahelegen.

segments.src: ## Indicators that give a fuller picture
segments.tr: ## Indikatoren, die ein umfassenderes Bild vermitteln

segments.src: No single statistic captures a labor market.
segments.tr: Keine einzelne Statistik erfasst einen Arbeitsmarkt.

segments.src: These are commonly used alongside jobless claims:
segments.tr: Diese werden häufig zusammen mit Arbeitslosenanträgen verwendet:

segments.src: 1. **Continuing claims.** This measures people who are still receiving benefits after an initial claim. When continuing claims rise while initial claims stay low, it can mean laid-off workers are taking longer to find new jobs.
segments.tr: 1. **Fortlaufende Anträge (Continuing claims).** Dies misst Personen, die nach einem Erstantrag weiterhin Leistungen erhalten. Wenn fortlaufende Anträge steigen, während Erstanträge niedrig bleiben, kann dies bedeuten, dass entlassene Arbeitskräfte länger brauchen, um neue Jobs zu finden.

segments.src: 2. **Job openings and labor turnover (JOLTS).** The Bureau of Labor Statistics survey reports openings, hires, quits, and layoffs. The *hires rate* and the *quits rate* are especially useful for judging how dynamic the market is.
segments.tr: 2. **Offene Stellen und Arbeitsmarktfluktuation (JOLTS).** Die Umfrage des Bureau of Labor Statistics berichtet über offene Stellen, Einstellungen, freiwillige Kündigungen und Entlassungen. Die *Einstellungsrate* (hires rate) und die *Kündigungsrate* (quits rate) sind besonders nützlich, um zu beurteilen, wie dynamisch der Markt ist.

segments.src: 3. **Monthly payroll employment.** The jobs report shows net job growth. Pay attention to revisions, since early estimates are often adjusted later.
segments.tr: 3. **Monatliche Beschäftigung in den Lohn- und Gehaltslisten (Payroll employment).** Der Jobbericht zeigt das Netto-Jobwachstum. Achten Sie auf Revisionen, da frühe Schätzungen später oft angepasst werden.

segments.src: 4. **The unemployment rate and its duration breakdown.** A rising share of long-term unemployed workers suggests that finding work is getting harder, even if the overall rate looks stable.
segments.tr: 4. **Die Arbeitslosenquote und ihre Aufteilung nach Dauer.** Ein steigernder Anteil langzeitarbeitsloser Arbeitskräfte deutet darauf hin, dass es schwieriger wird, Arbeit zu finden, selbst wenn die Gesamtquote stabil aussieht.

segments.src: 5. **Labor force participation and the employment-population ratio.** These show whether people are working or looking, or have stepped away from the market.
segments.tr: 5. **Erwerbsbeteiligung und Beschäftigungs-Bevölkerungs-Verhältnis.** Diese zeigen, ob Menschen arbeiten, suchen oder sich vom Markt zurückgezogen haben.

segments.src: 6. **Wage growth.** Measures such as the Employment Cost Index and average hourly earnings indicate whether employers are competing for workers.
segments.tr: 6. **Lohnwachstum.** Maßnahmen wie der Employment Cost Index und durchschnittliche Stundenverdienste zeigen an, ob Arbeitgeber um Arbeitskräfte konkurrieren.

segments.src: 7. **Surveys of workers and employers.** Consumer confidence surveys often ask whether jobs are "plentiful" or "hard to get," and business surveys ask about hiring plans. These capture sentiment that hard counts miss.
segments.tr: 7. **Umfragen unter Arbeitnehmern und Arbeitgebern.** Verbrauchervertrauensumfragen fragen oft, ob Jobs „reichlich vorhanden“ oder „schwer zu bekommen“ sind, und Unternehmensumfragen fragen nach Plänen zur Einstellung. Diese erfassen Stimmungen, die harte Zählungen verfehlen.

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers without overreacting
segments.tr: ## Wie man die Zahlen liest, ohne überzureagieren

segments.src: - **Look at trends, not single weeks.** Weekly claims are noisy. Holidays, seasonal patterns, and local events such as weather or a plant closure can shift a single reading. A four-week average smooths some of this out.
segments.tr: - **Betrachten Sie Trends, nicht einzelne Wochen.** Wöchentliche Anträge sind unruhig. Feiertage, saisonale Muster und lokale Ereignisse wie Wetter oder eine Werksschließung können einen einzelnen Messwert verschieben. Ein Vier-Wochen-Durchschnitt glättet davoniges.

segments.src: - **Compare across indicators.** If claims are low but hires and quits are also low, the market is probably stable but stagnant, not strong.
segments.tr: - **Vergleichen Sie über Indikatoren hinweg.** Wenn die Anträge niedrig sind, aber auch Einstellungen und Kündigungen niedrig sind, ist der Markt wahrscheinlich stabil, aber stagnierend, nicht stark.

segments.src: - **Remember that "low" is relative.** The labor force is much larger than in past decades, so a low count of claims should be viewed alongside the size of the workforce.
segments.tr: - **Denken Sie daran, dass „niedrig“ relativ ist.** Die Erwerbsbevölkerung ist viel größer als in vergangenen Jahrzehnten, daher sollte eine niedrige Anzahl von Anträgen im Vergleich zur Größe der Belegschaft betrachtet werden.

segments.src: - **Expect revisions.** Many labor statistics are revised after first publication, and the story can change.
segments.tr: - **Erwarten Sie Revisionen.** Viele Arbeitsmarktstatistiken werden nach der ersten Veröffentlichung überarbeitet, und die Geschichte kann sich ändern.

segments.src: ## What this means for job seekers and workers
segments.tr: ## Was dies für Arbeitssuchende und Arbeitnehmer bedeutet

segments.src: Low layoffs are good news for people who are currently employed, but they do not guarantee that the search for a new role will be quick.
segments.tr: Geringe Entlassungen sind eine gute Nachricht für Personen, die derzeit beschäftigt sind, garantieren jedoch nicht, dass die Suche nach einer neuen Rolle schnell geht.

segments.src: If you are looking for work, some practical steps may help:
segments.tr: Wenn Sie nach Arbeit suchen, können einige praktische Schritte helfen:

segments.src: - Focus on sectors and regions where hiring data shows real activity.
segments.tr: - Konzentrieren Sie sich auf Branchen und Regionen, in denen Einstellungsdaten reale Aktivität zeigen.

segments.src: - Expect longer timelines and plan your finances accordingly.
segments.tr: - Erwarten Sie längere Zeitrahmen und planen Sie Ihre Finanzen entsprechend.

segments.src: - Keep skills and professional networks current, since many openings are filled through referrals.
segments.tr: - Halten Sie Fähigkeiten und berufliche Netzwerke aktuell, da viele offene Stellen über Empfehlungen besetzt werden.

segments.src: - Consider the full compensation picture, not just the headline salary, when weighing offers.
segments.tr: - Berücksichtigen Sie das gesamte Vergütungsbild, nicht nur das Schlagzeilengehalt, wenn Sie Angebote abwägen.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: Jobless claims are a useful early warning for layoffs, and a very low reading signals that employers are not shedding workers in large numbers.
segments.tr: Arbeitslosenanträge sind ein nützlicher Frühwarnindikator für Entlassungen, und ein sehr niedriger Wert signalisiert, dass Arbeitgeber in großer Zahl keine Arbeitskräfte abbauen.

segments.src: But a healthy-looking claims figure and a sluggish hiring environment are not contradictory.
segments.tr: Aber eine gesund aussehende Antragszahl und ein träges Einstellungsumfeld widersprechen sich nicht.

segments.src: To judge how the job market is really doing, look at claims together with hires, quits, openings, duration of unemployment, and wage trends.
segments.tr: Um zu beurteilen, wie es dem Arbeitsmarkt wirklich geht, betrachten Sie Anträge zusammen mit Einstellungen, Kündigungen, offenen Stellen, der Dauer der Arbeitslosigkeit und Lohntrends.

vi.title: Ít Sa thải, Ít Tuyển dụng: Số Đơn xin Trợ cấp Thất nghiệp Thấp Kỷ lục Nói lên và Không Nói lên Điều Gì

segments.src: Weekly jobless claims have recently sat near the lowest levels seen in decades.
segments.tr: Số đơn xin trợ cấp thất nghiệp hàng tuần gần đây vẫn ở mức thấp nhất trong nhiều thập kỷ.

segments.src: Yet many job seekers describe a market that feels slow: fewer openings, longer searches, and more rounds of interviews.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, nhiều người tìm việc lại mô tả một thị trường có vẻ chậm chạp: ít vị trí trống hơn, thời gian tìm kiếm kéo dài hơn và nhiều vòng phỏng vấn hơn.

segments.src: Both pictures can be true at once.
segments.tr: Cả hai bức tranh này đều có thể đúng cùng một lúc.

segments.src: This article explains why the layoff data and the hiring data can point in different directions, and which indicators help fill in the rest of the picture.
segments.tr: Bài viết này giải thích lý do tại sao dữ liệu sa thải và dữ liệu tuyển dụng có thể chỉ về các hướng khác nhau, và những chỉ báo nào giúp hoàn thiện phần còn lại của bức tranh.

segments.src: ## What jobless claims actually measure
segments.tr: ## Số đơn xin trợ cấp thất nghiệp thực sự đo lường điều gì

segments.src: Initial jobless claims count the number of people who file for unemployment insurance benefits for the first time in a given week.
segments.tr: Số đơn xin trợ cấp thất nghiệp ban đầu đếm số lượng người nộp đơn xin bảo hiểm thất nghiệp lần đầu tiên trong một tuần nhất định.

segments.src: The figure is published weekly by the U.S.
segments.tr: Con số này được công bố hàng tuần bởi Bộ

segments.src: Department of Labor, which makes it one of the fastest-moving signals about the labor market.
segments.tr: Lao động Hoa Kỳ, điều này làm cho nó trở thành một trong những tín hiệu thay đổi nhanh nhất về thị trường lao động.

segments.src: That speed is its strength.
segments.tr: Tốc độ đó là sức mạnh của nó.

segments.src: It is also its limit.
segments.tr: Đó cũng là giới hạn của nó.

segments.src: Claims capture **layoffs**, meaning people who lose a job and apply for benefits.
segments.tr: Số đơn ghi nhận các vụ **sa thải**, có nghĩa là những người mất việc làm và nộp đơn xin trợ cấp.

segments.src: They say very little about:
segments.tr: Chúng rất ít đề cập đến:

segments.src: - **Hiring**: how many people are being brought on.
segments.tr: - **Tuyển dụng**: có bao nhiêu người đang được nhận vào làm.

segments.src: - **Quits**: workers who leave voluntarily and generally do not qualify for benefits.
segments.tr: - **Nghỉ việc**: những người lao động tự nguyện rời đi và thường không đủ điều kiện nhận trợ cấp.

segments.src: - **New entrants and re-entrants**: graduates, caregivers returning to work, or others who have not recently held a covered job.
segments.tr: - **Người lao động mới và tái gia nhập**: sinh viên tốt nghiệp, người chăm sóc gia đình quay trở lại làm việc, hoặc những người khác gần đây không giữ việc làm được bảo hiểm.

segments.src: - **Eligibility gaps**: some workers do not qualify for benefits, and some who qualify never file.
segments.tr: - **Khoảng cách đủ điều kiện**: một số người lao động không đủ điều kiện nhận trợ cấp, và một số người đủ điều kiện nhưng không bao giờ nộp đơn.

segments.src: A low claims number therefore means that few people are being pushed out of jobs.
segments.tr: Do đó, một con số đơn xin thấp có nghĩa là ít người bị đẩy ra khỏi công việc.

segments.src: It does not mean many people are being pulled into new ones.
segments.tr: Điều đó không có nghĩa là nhiều người được kéo vào những công việc mới.

segments.src: ## Why layoffs and hiring can diverge
segments.tr: ## Tại sao sa thải và tuyển dụng có thể phân kỳ

segments.src: ### Employers are holding on to workers
segments.tr: ### Người sử dụng lao động đang giữ chân người lao động

segments.src: After the staffing shortages of recent years, many employers became wary of letting people go.
segments.tr: Sau tình trạng thiếu nhân lực trong những năm gần đây, nhiều chủ sử dụng lao động đã trở nên thận trọng trong việc cho nhân viên nghỉ việc.

segments.src: Recruiting and training are expensive, and companies that struggled to fill roles may prefer to keep existing staff even when demand softens.
segments.tr: Tuyển dụng và đào tạo rất tốn kém, và các công ty từng chật vật lấp đầy các vị trí có thể thích giữ lại nhân viên hiện tại ngay cả khi nhu cầu suy yếu.

segments.src: That keeps layoffs low.
segments.tr: Điều đó giúp giữ mức sa thải ở mức thấp.

segments.src: ### Caution slows hiring at the same time
segments.tr: ### Sự thận trọng làm chậm việc tuyển dụng cùng lúc đó

segments.src: The same caution that discourages layoffs can discourage new hiring.
segments.tr: Cùng một sự thận trọng ngăn cản việc sa thải cũng có thể ngăn cản việc tuyển dụng mới.

segments.src: When businesses are unsure about interest rates, costs, or future demand, a common response is to freeze headcount: don't cut, but don't add.
segments.tr: Khi các doanh nghiệp không chắc chắn về lãi suất, chi phí hoặc nhu cầu tương lai, phản ứng phổ biến là đóng băng số lượng nhân sự: không cắt giảm, nhưng cũng không thêm vào.

segments.src: The result is a market with little churn.
segments.tr: Kết quả là một thị trường có ít sự thay đổi nhân sự.

segments.src: ### A "low-hire, low-fire" market
segments.tr: ### Thị trường "tuyển dụng ít, sa thải ít"

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a low-hire, low-fire labor market.
segments.tr: Các nhà kinh tế thường mô hình hóa xu hướng này như một thị trường lao động tuyển dụng ít, sa thải ít.

segments.src: Workers who have jobs tend to feel relatively secure.
segments.tr: Những người lao động có việc làm có xu hướng cảm thấy tương đối an toàn.

segments.src: Workers who are looking for jobs, or who want to switch, find fewer chances.
segments.tr: Những người đang tìm việc, hoặc muốn chuyển việc, thấy ít cơ hội hơn.

segments.src: Because people change jobs less often, fewer openings are created by turnover, which makes the search feel harder even when layoffs are rare.
segments.tr: Vì mọi người thay đổi công việc ít thường xuyên hơn, nên ít vị trí trống được tạo ra bởi sự thay đổi nhân sự, điều này làm cho việc tìm kiếm có cảm giác khó khăn hơn ngay cả khi các vụ sa thải là hiếm.

segments.src: ### The experience is uneven
segments.tr: ### Trải nghiệm là không đồng đều

segments.src: National averages can hide big differences.
segments.tr: Các mức trung bình quốc gia có thể che giấu những khác biệt lớn.

segments.src: Some industries and regions hire steadily while others are cutting back.
segments.tr: Một số ngành và khu vực tuyển dụng ổn định trong khi những ngành khác đang cắt giảm.

segments.src: Entry-level applicants, people changing careers, and workers in fields with heavy automation or restructuring may have a very different experience than the headline numbers suggest.
segments.tr: Những người xin việc cấp độ đầu vào, những người thay đổi nghề nghiệp, và người lao động trong các lĩnh vực có mức độ tự động hóa hoặc tái cơ cấu cao có thể có trải nghiệm rất khác so với những gì các con số tiêu đề gợi ý.

segments.src: ## Indicators that give a fuller picture
segments.tr: ## Các chỉ báo mang lại bức tranh toàn diện hơn

segments.src: No single statistic captures a labor market.
segments.tr: Không có một thống kê đơn lẻ nào nắm bắt được toàn bộ thị trường lao động.

segments.src: These are commonly used alongside jobless claims:
segments.tr: Những chỉ báo này thường được sử dụng cùng với số đơn xin trợ cấp thất nghiệp:

segments.src: 1. **Continuing claims.** This measures people who are still receiving benefits after an initial claim. When continuing claims rise while initial claims stay low, it can mean laid-off workers are taking longer to find new jobs.
segments.tr: 1. **Đơn tiếp tục nhận trợ cấp.** Điều này đo lường những người vẫn đang nhận trợ cấp sau đơn ban đầu. Khi số đơn tiếp tục tăng trong khi số đơn ban đầu vẫn thấp, điều đó có thể có nghĩa là người lao động bị sa thải mất nhiều thời gian hơn để tìm việc làm mới.

segments.src: 2. **Job openings and labor turnover (JOLTS).** The Bureau of Labor Statistics survey reports openings, hires, quits, and layoffs. The *hires rate* and the *quits rate* are especially useful for judging how dynamic the market is.
segments.tr: 2. **Việc làm trống và luân chuyển lao động (JOLTS).** Khảo sát của Cục Thống kê Lao động báo cáo các vị trí trống, tuyển dụng, nghỉ việc và sa thải. *Tỷ lệ tuyển dụng* và *tỷ lệ nghỉ việc* đặc biệt hữu ích để đánh giá mức độ năng động của thị trường.

segments.src: 3. **Monthly payroll employment.** The jobs report shows net job growth. Pay attention to revisions, since early estimates are often adjusted later.
segments.tr: 3. **Việc làm bảng lương hàng tháng.** Báo cáo việc làm cho thấy tăng trưởng việc làm ròng. Hãy chú ý đến các đợt điều chỉnh, vì các ước tính ban đầu thường được điều chỉnh sau đó.

segments.src: 4. **The unemployment rate and its duration breakdown.** A rising share of long-term unemployed workers suggests that finding work is getting harder, even if the overall rate looks stable.
segments.tr: 4. **Tỷ lệ thất nghiệp và phân tích theo thời gian.** Tỷ trọng người thất nghiệp dài hạn gia tăng cho thấy việc tìm kiếm việc làm đang trở nên khó khăn hơn, ngay cả khi tỷ lệ tổng thể có vẻ ổn định.

segments.src: 5. **Labor force participation and the employment-population ratio.** These show whether people are working or looking, or have stepped away from the market.
segments.tr: 5. **Tỷ lệ tham gia lực lượng lao động và tỷ lệ việc làm trên dân số.** Những chỉ số này cho thấy liệu mọi người đang làm việc hay tìm kiếm, hay đã rời khỏi thị trường.

segments.src: 6. **Wage growth.** Measures such as the Employment Cost Index and average hourly earnings indicate whether employers are competing for workers.
segments.tr: 6. **Tăng trưởng tiền lương.** Các biện pháp như Chỉ số Chi phí Lao động và thu nhập bình quân theo giờ cho biết liệu người sử dụng lao động có đang cạnh tranh để giành giật người lao động hay không.

segments.src: 7. **Surveys of workers and employers.** Consumer confidence surveys often ask whether jobs are "plentiful" or "hard to get," and business surveys ask about hiring plans. These capture sentiment that hard counts miss.
segments.tr: 7. **Khảo sát người lao động và người sử dụng lao động.** Các cuộc khảo sát niềm tin người tiêu dùng thường hỏi xem việc làm có "dồi dào" hay "khó tìm" hay không, và các khảo sát kinh doanh hỏi về kế hoạch tuyển dụng. Những cuộc khảo sát này nắm bắt tâm lý mà các con số cứng bỏ sót.

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers without overreacting
segments.tr: ## Cách đọc các con số mà không phản ứng thái quá

segments.src: - **Look at trends, not single weeks.** Weekly claims are noisy. Holidays, seasonal patterns, and local events such as weather or a plant closure can shift a single reading. A four-week average smooths some of this out.
segments.tr: - **Nhìn vào các xu hướng, không phải các tuần đơn lẻ.** Số đơn hàng tuần có nhiều biến động. Ngày lễ, mô hình theo mùa và các sự kiện địa phương như thời tiết hoặc việc đóng cửa nhà máy có thể làm thay đổi một kết quả đơn lẻ. Mức trung bình bốn tuần làm phẳng bớt những biến động này.

segments.src: - **Compare across indicators.** If claims are low but hires and quits are also low, the market is probably stable but stagnant, not strong.
segments.tr: - **So sánh giữa các chỉ báo.** Nếu số đơn xin trợ cấp thấp nhưng số người được tuyển dụng và nghỉ việc cũng thấp, thị trường có thể đang ổn định nhưng trì trệ chứ không phải mạnh mẽ.

segments.src: - **Remember that "low" is relative.** The labor force is much larger than in past decades, so a low count of claims should be viewed alongside the size of the workforce.
segments.tr: - **Hãy nhớ rằng "thấp" chỉ là tương đối.** Lực lượng lao động lớn hơn nhiều so với các thập kỷ trước, vì vậy một số lượng thấp các đơn xin trợ cấp nên được xem xét cùng với quy mô của lực lượng lao động.

segments.src: - **Expect revisions.** Many labor statistics are revised after first publication, and the story can change.
segments.tr: - **Mong đợi các đợt điều chỉnh.** Nhiều thống kê lao động được điều chỉnh sau lần công bố đầu tiên, và câu chuyện có thể thay đổi.

segments.src: ## What this means for job seekers and workers
segments.tr: ## Điều này có ý nghĩa gì đối với người tìm việc và người lao động

segments.src: Low layoffs are good news for people who are currently employed, but they do not guarantee that the search for a new role will be quick.
segments.tr: Tình trạng sa thải thấp là tin vui cho những người hiện đang có việc làm, nhưng chúng không đảm bảo rằng việc tìm kiếm một vai trò mới sẽ diễn ra nhanh chóng.

segments.src: If you are looking for work, some practical steps may help:
segments.tr: Nếu bạn đang tìm việc, một số bước thiết thực có thể giúp ích:

segments.src: - Focus on sectors and regions where hiring data shows real activity.
segments.tr: - Tập trung vào các lĩnh vực và khu vực mà dữ liệu tuyển dụng cho thấy hoạt động thực tế.

segments.src: - Expect longer timelines and plan your finances accordingly.
segments.tr: - Dự kiến thời gian kéo dài hơn và lên kế hoạch tài chính cho phù hợp.

segments.src: - Keep skills and professional networks current, since many openings are filled through referrals.
segments.tr: - Giữ cho các kỹ năng và mạng lưới chuyên nghiệp luôn cập nhật, vì nhiều vị trí trống được lấp đầy thông qua giới thiệu.

segments.src: - Consider the full compensation picture, not just the headline salary, when weighing offers.
segments.tr: - Xem xét bức tranh tổng thể về chế độ đãi ngộ, không chỉ mức lương cơ bản, khi cân nhắc các lời đề nghị.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: Jobless claims are a useful early warning for layoffs, and a very low reading signals that employers are not shedding workers in large numbers.
segments.tr: Số đơn xin trợ cấp thất nghiệp là một cảnh báo sớm hữu ích cho việc sa thải, và một kết quả rất thấp báo hiệu rằng người sử dụng lao động không sa thải người lao động với số lượng lớn.

segments.src: But a healthy-looking claims figure and a sluggish hiring environment are not contradictory.
segments.tr: Nhưng một con số đơn xin trợ cấp có vẻ lành mạnh và một môi trường tuyển dụng ì ạch không hề mâu thuẫn với nhau.

segments.src: To judge how the job market is really doing, look at claims together with hires, quits, openings, duration of unemployment, and wage trends.
segments.tr: Để đánh giá thị trường việc làm thực sự đang hoạt động như thế nào, hãy xem xét số đơn xin trợ cấp cùng với số lượng tuyển dụng, nghỉ việc, vị trí trống, thời gian thất nghiệp và xu hướng tiền lương.

ko.title: 적은 해고, 적은 채용: 역대 최저 수준의 실업수당 청구 건수가 말해주는 것과 말해주지 않는 것

segments.src: Weekly jobless claims have recently sat near the lowest levels seen in decades.
segments.tr: 주간 실업수당 청구 건수가 최근 수십 년 만에 최저 수준에 머물러 있습니다.

segments.src: Yet many job seekers describe a market that feels slow: fewer openings, longer searches, and more rounds of interviews.
segments.tr: 하지만 많은 구직자들은 일자리가 줄어들고, 구직 기간이 길어지며, 면접 전형이 늘어나는 등 시장이 더디게 느껴진다고 말합니다.

segments.src: Both pictures can be true at once.
segments.tr: 이 두 가지 모습은 모두 사실일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This article explains why the layoff data and the hiring data can point in different directions, and which indicators help fill in the rest of the picture.
segments.tr: 이 글에서는 해고 데이터와 채용 데이터가 서로 다른 방향을 가리킬 수 있는 이유와, 나머지 퍼즐을 맞추는 데 도움이 되는 지표가 무엇인지 설명합니다.

segments.src: ## What jobless claims actually measure
segments.tr: ## 실업수당 청구가 실제로 측정하는 것

segments.src: Initial jobless claims count the number of people who file for unemployment insurance benefits for the first time in a given week.
segments.tr: 신규 실업수당 청구 건수는 특정 주에 처음으로 실업보험 혜택을 신청한 사람들의 수를 집계합니다.

segments.src: The figure is published weekly by the U.S.
segments.tr: 이 수치는 미국

segments.src: Department of Labor, which makes it one of the fastest-moving signals about the labor market.
segments.tr: 노동부에서 매주 발표하므로 노동 시장에 대한 가장 빠르게 변하는 신호 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: That speed is its strength.
segments.tr: 그 속도가 바로 장점입니다.

segments.src: It is also its limit.
segments.tr: 또한 그것이 한계이기도 합니다.

segments.src: Claims capture **layoffs**, meaning people who lose a job and apply for benefits.
segments.tr: 청구 건수는 **해고**, 즉 일자리를 잃고 혜택을 신청하는 사람들을 포착합니다.

segments.src: They say very little about:
segments.tr: 다음 사항에 대해서는 거의 알려주지 않습니다.

segments.src: - **Hiring**: how many people are being brought on.
segments.tr: - **채용**: 얼마나 많은 사람이 새로 고용되는지.

segments.src: - **Quits**: workers who leave voluntarily and generally do not qualify for benefits.
segments.tr: - **자발적 퇴사**: 자발적으로 회사를 떠나며 일반적으로 혜택을 받을 자격이 없는 노동자들.

segments.src: - **New entrants and re-entrants**: graduates, caregivers returning to work, or others who have not recently held a covered job.
segments.tr: - **신규 진입자 및 재진입자**: 졸업생, 일터로 복귀하는 양육자, 또는 최근에 적용 대상 일자리를 갖지 않았던 사람들.

segments.src: - **Eligibility gaps**: some workers do not qualify for benefits, and some who qualify never file.
segments.tr: - **수급 자격 격차**: 일부 노동자는 혜택을 받을 자격이 없고, 자격을 갖춘 이들 중에도 아예 신청하지 않는 경우가 있습니다.

segments.src: A low claims number therefore means that few people are being pushed out of jobs.
segments.tr: 따라서 낮은 청구 건수는 일자리에서 밀려나는 사람이 거의 없음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: It does not mean many people are being pulled into new ones.
segments.tr: 새로운 일자리로 유입되는 사람이 많다는 뜻은 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## Why layoffs and hiring can diverge
segments.tr: ## 해고와 채용이 엇갈릴 수 있는 이유

segments.src: ### Employers are holding on to workers
segments.tr: ### 고용주들이 노동자를 붙잡고 있습니다

segments.src: After the staffing shortages of recent years, many employers became wary of letting people go.
segments.tr: 최근 몇 년간의 인력난을 겪은 후, 많은 고용주들은 사람들을 내보내는 것을 꺼리게 되었습니다.

segments.src: Recruiting and training are expensive, and companies that struggled to fill roles may prefer to keep existing staff even when demand softens.
segments.tr: 채용과 교육에는 비용이 많이 들며, 인력 충원에 어려움을 겪었던 기업들은 수요가 둔화될 때조차 기존 직원을 유지하는 것을 선호할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That keeps layoffs low.
segments.tr: 그것이 해고를 낮게 유지합니다.

segments.src: ### Caution slows hiring at the same time
segments.tr: ### 신중함이 동시에 채용을 늦춥니다

segments.src: The same caution that discourages layoffs can discourage new hiring.
segments.tr: 해고를 꺼리게 만드는 바로 그 신중함이 신규 채용을 주저하게 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: When businesses are unsure about interest rates, costs, or future demand, a common response is to freeze headcount: don't cut, but don't add.
segments.tr: 기업이 금리, 비용, 또는 향후 수요에 대해 확신이 없을 때 흔히 취하는 대응은 헤드카운트(인원수)를 동결하는 것입니다. 즉, 줄이지도 않지만 늘리지도 않는 것입니다.

segments.src: The result is a market with little churn.
segments.tr: 그 결과는 변동이 거의 없는 시장입니다.

segments.src: ### A "low-hire, low-fire" market
segments.tr: ### "저채용, 저해고" 시장

segments.src: Economists often describe this pattern as a low-hire, low-fire labor market.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 종종 이 패턴을 저채용, 저해고 노동 시장으로 묘사합니다.

segments.src: Workers who have jobs tend to feel relatively secure.
segments.tr: 일자리가 있는 노동자들은 비교적 안정감을 느끼는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Workers who are looking for jobs, or who want to switch, find fewer chances.
segments.tr: 일자리를 찾고 있거나 이직을 원하는 노동자들은 기회를 찾기 더 어렵습니다.

segments.src: Because people change jobs less often, fewer openings are created by turnover, which makes the search feel harder even when layoffs are rare.
segments.tr: 사람들이 이직을 덜 자주 하기 때문에 이직으로 인해 생겨나는 일자리가 줄어들고, 이로 인해 해고가 드문 상황에서도 구직 활동이 더 어렵게 느껴집니다.

segments.src: ### The experience is uneven
segments.tr: ### 경험은 고르지 않습니다

segments.src: National averages can hide big differences.
segments.tr: 전국 평균은 큰 차이를 숨길 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Some industries and regions hire steadily while others are cutting back.
segments.tr: 어떤 산업과 지역은 꾸준히 채용하는 반면 다른 곳은 규모를 줄이고 있습니다.

segments.src: Entry-level applicants, people changing careers, and workers in fields with heavy automation or restructuring may have a very different experience than the headline numbers suggest.
segments.tr: 초년생 지원자, 경력 전환자, 자동화나 구조조정이 심한 분야의 노동자들은 헤드라인 수치가 시사하는 것과 매우 다른 경험을 할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Indicators that give a fuller picture
segments.tr: ## 더 온전한 그림을 보여주는 지표들

segments.src: No single statistic captures a labor market.
segments.tr: 단 하나의 통계만으로는 노동 시장을 온전히 담아낼 수 없습니다.

segments.src: These are commonly used alongside jobless claims:
segments.tr: 다음 지표들이 실업수당 청구 건수와 함께 흔히 사용됩니다:

segments.src: 1. **Continuing claims.** This measures people who are still receiving benefits after an initial claim. When continuing claims rise while initial claims stay low, it can mean laid-off workers are taking longer to find new jobs.
segments.tr: 1. **연속 실업수당 청구(Continuing claims).** 이는 최초 청구 이후에도 계속 혜택을 받고 있는 사람들을 측정합니다. 최초 청구 건수는 낮은데 연속 청구 건수가 증가할 경우, 해고된 노동자들이 새 일자리를 찾는 데 더 오랜 시간이 걸리고 있음을 의미할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Job openings and labor turnover (JOLTS).** The Bureau of Labor Statistics survey reports openings, hires, quits, and layoffs. The *hires rate* and the *quits rate* are especially useful for judging how dynamic the market is.
segments.tr: 2. **구인 및 노동 회전율 조사(JOLTS).** 노동통계국의 이 조사는 구인, 채용, 퇴사, 해고를 보고합니다. *채용률*과 *퇴사율*은 시장이 얼마나 역동적인지 판단하는 데 특히 유용합니다.

segments.src: 3. **Monthly payroll employment.** The jobs report shows net job growth. Pay attention to revisions, since early estimates are often adjusted later.
segments.tr: 3. **월간 비농업 취업자 수.** 일자리 보고서는 순 일자리 증가를 보여줍니다. 초기 추정치는 나중에 수정되는 경우가 많으므로 수정치를 주의 깊게 보아야 합니다.

segments.src: 4. **The unemployment rate and its duration breakdown.** A rising share of long-term unemployed workers suggests that finding work is getting harder, even if the overall rate looks stable.
segments.tr: 4. **실업률 및 기간별 분석.** 장기 실업자의 비율이 증가한다는 것은 전체 실업률이 안정적으로 보여도 일자리를 구하기가 점점 더 어려워지고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: 5. **Labor force participation and the employment-population ratio.** These show whether people are working or looking, or have stepped away from the market.
segments.tr: 5. **경제활동참가율 및 고용-인구 비율.** 이는 사람들이 일하고 있거나 구직 중인지, 아니면 시장을 떠났는지를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: 6. **Wage growth.** Measures such as the Employment Cost Index and average hourly earnings indicate whether employers are competing for workers.
segments.tr: 6. **임금 상승률.** 고용비용지수 및 평균 시간당 임금과 같은 측정치는 고용주들이 노동자를 얻기 위해 경쟁하고 있는지 나타냅니다.

segments.src: 7. **Surveys of workers and employers.** Consumer confidence surveys often ask whether jobs are "plentiful" or "hard to get," and business surveys ask about hiring plans. These capture sentiment that hard counts miss.
segments.tr: 7. **노동자와 고용주 대상 설문조사.** 소비자 심리 조사는 종종 일자리가 "풍부한지" 또는 "구하기 어려운지" 묻고, 기업 조사는 채용 계획에 대해 묻습니다. 이들은 단순 집계로 놓치는 심리를 포착합니다.

segments.src: ## How to read the numbers without overreacting
segments.tr: ## 과민반응하지 않고 숫자를 읽는 방법

segments.src: - **Look at trends, not single weeks.** Weekly claims are noisy. Holidays, seasonal patterns, and local events such as weather or a plant closure can shift a single reading. A four-week average smooths some of this out.
segments.tr: - **단일 주간이 아니라 추세를 살펴보세요.** 주간 청구 건수는 변동성이 큽니다. 휴일, 계절적 패턴, 날씨나 공장 폐쇄 같은 지역적 사건은 단일 수치를 흔들 수 있습니다. 4주 평균은 이러한 변동 중 일부를 평탄화해 줍니다.

segments.src: - **Compare across indicators.** If claims are low but hires and quits are also low, the market is probably stable but stagnant, not strong.
segments.tr: - **지표를 상호 비교하세요.** 청구 건수는 낮은데 채용과 퇴사 역시 낮다면, 시장이 강한 것이 아니라 안정되어 있으되 정체되어 있을 가능성이 큽니다.

segments.src: - **Remember that "low" is relative.** The labor force is much larger than in past decades, so a low count of claims should be viewed alongside the size of the workforce.
segments.tr: - **"낮다"는 것은 상대적임을 기억하세요.** 노동력 규모가 과거 수십 년에 비해 훨씬 커졌으므로, 청구 건수가 적다는 것은 노동력의 규모와 함께 살펴봐야 합니다.

segments.src: - **Expect revisions.** Many labor statistics are revised after first publication, and the story can change.
segments.tr: - **수정치를 예상하세요.** 많은 노동 통계는 최초 발표 후에 수정되며, 상황이 달라질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What this means for job seekers and workers
segments.tr: ## 이것이 구직자와 노동자에게 의미하는 바

segments.src: Low layoffs are good news for people who are currently employed, but they do not guarantee that the search for a new role will be quick.
segments.tr: 낮은 해고율은 현재 고용되어 있는 사람들에게는 좋은 소식이지만, 새로운 역할을 찾는 과정이 빠를 것이라고 보장해 주지는 않습니다.

segments.src: If you are looking for work, some practical steps may help:
segments.tr: 구직 중이라면 다음과 같은 실천적 단계들이 도움이 될 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - Focus on sectors and regions where hiring data shows real activity.
segments.tr: - 채용 데이터가 실제 활황을 보여주는 부문과 지역에 집중하세요.

segments.src: - Expect longer timelines and plan your finances accordingly.
segments.tr: - 더 긴 소요 기간을 예상하고 그에 맞춰 재정을 계획하세요.

segments.src: - Keep skills and professional networks current, since many openings are filled through referrals.
segments.tr: - 많은 채용이 추천을 통해 이루어지므로 기술과 전문 네트워크를 최신 상태로 유지하세요.

segments.src: - Consider the full compensation picture, not just the headline salary, when weighing offers.
segments.tr: - 제안을 저울질할 때 헤드라인 급여뿐만 아니라 전체 보상 그림을 고려하세요.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Jobless claims are a useful early warning for layoffs, and a very low reading signals that employers are not shedding workers in large numbers.
segments.tr: 실업수당 청구 건수는 해고에 대한 유용한 조기 경보이며, 매우 낮은 수치는 고용주들이 대규모로 인원을 감축하고 있지 않음을 신호합니다.

segments.src: But a healthy-looking claims figure and a sluggish hiring environment are not contradictory.
segments.tr: 하지만 건강해 보이는 청구 수치와 부진한 채용 환경은 모순되지 않습니다.

segments.src: To judge how the job market is really doing, look at claims together with hires, quits, openings, duration of unemployment, and wage trends.
segments.tr: 고용 시장이 실제로 어떻게 돌아가고 있는지 판단하려면, 청구 건수를 채용, 퇴사, 구인, 실업 기간, 임금 추세와 함께 살펴보아야 합니다.
